features.notes: COMPLETE, commit 9bb55847f. All 10 literals gone (5 in factory.go DefaultConfig + 5 per-executor). DESIGN ERROR MADE AND CORRECTED: the first cut failed at CONSTRUCTION - all tests green, guard passed, but WRONG. NewExecutorProvider builds an executor from the global factory BEFORE it knows the task; the model arrives later as Task.Model. That broke the production path and TestExecutorRegistration_AutoDiscovery caught it for all 5 harnesses. requireModel now runs first in Execute/ExecuteStreaming where both model sources are known. Consequence: M6 does NOT depend on M7 - the coupling noted earlier was an artefact of the wrong design. Path defaults survive, model defaults do not. Guard covers factory.go, verified twice by reintroducing a literal. opencode_test.go split at the 800-line gate. Full suite 0 failures.

features.notes: PARKED (Mark 2026-08-27: 'if it ain't broken won't fix'). The milestone's premise was wrong: scoped as 'read a value from a CLI', but the driver has a multi-tier multi-provider scheme with ratified rationale. TWO silent-degradation traps found before touching it: (1) the registry yields `claude:fable`, but the driver pins `claude:claude-fable-5` because the Agent tool only accepts sonnet|opus|haiku - a bare `fable` silently falls back to OPUS (F1, iteration 31); (2) per-role fallbacks ALREADY exist and are richer - two-deep, on `pi` (sees the uncommitted worktree), leading with an ollama-cloud flat-rate tier, plus a PLANNER_ANTHROPIC_FALLBACK the registry cannot express. Needs its own design doc.
